title: BembaHub Northern Province Icibemba QA Starter Pack
purpose: Manual QA fixture only. This file is not imported into production or the translation database.

target.label: Standard written Icibemba (Northern Province)
target.note: Candidate phrases are gathered from public learning resources, not certified as authoritative. A fluent Northern Province speaker must approve every expected translation before this pack is used as a gold-standard quality benchmark.

cases.sourceText: Good morning. I am going to the market today because we need food for the family. Please tell my brother that I will return before sunset.
cases.testNotes: Check complete meaning, sentence order, paragraph preservation, and no untranslated English sentences.

runInstructions: Run each case through the deployed BembaHub interface after confirming the backend deployment is Live.
